_comment: Fixes applied on top of GeoNames countryInfo. Every entry gives its source.

dropCountries.CS: Serbia and Montenegro — dissolved 2006; CLDR territoryAlias replaces it with RS ME
dropCountries.AN: Netherlands Antilles — dissolved 2010; CLDR territoryAlias replaces it with CW SX BQ

XK.source: Kosovo is in neither tzdata zone.tab nor CLDR; GeoNames gives every Kosovo city Europe/Belgrade (cities500)

currencies._comment: Currencies come from CLDR currencyData (with dates), which already fixes GeoNames' stale BG → BGN; no manual entries needed.
